statement: For every x in R_{>=0}^{16} satisfying |supp(x)| <= 5, the d=4 Hypercube Inequality P_4(x)(sum_v x_v)^3 <= Q_4(x) holds. Within this restricted domain, equality holds if and only if supp(x) is contained in one of the eight facets of V_4. This statement does not cover supports of size at least six and does not resolve the original universal claim (HC4).
contribution: A complete exact classification of the first nontrivial sparse-support layer requested by the source: all 4,368 five-vertex subsets are reduced to 27 full-cube-symmetry orbits, their normalized volumes are recomputed by integer determinants, and each of the 17 affinely independent orbit gaps is certified coefficientwise nonnegative by a fully serialized integer expansion; the 10 dependent orbits and the equality cases are also resolved. The bounded source comparison found no equivalent classification, but no priority claim is made pending fresh review.
